source_note: Labour Code of the Republic of Armenia ՀՕ-124-Ն (arlis.am redaction 23.12.2022-06.04.2023; owner confirmed current 22 Nov 2026). Quotes and article reading in docs/legal/PRE_REVIEW.md. Lawyer must confirm.
basis: Art. 93(1): employer may end the employment before probation ends with 3 days' written notice; Art. 93(2): same 3 days when the probation was set at the employee's request.

title.hy: Փորձաշրջանը շուտով ավարտվում է․ դադարեցման դեպքում ծանուցել առնվազն 3 օր առաջ
title.ru: Испытательный срок скоро закончится: при расторжении предупредить письменно за 3 дня
title.en: Probation ends soon: give 3 days' written notice if ending employment

edge_cases: Reminder window is 14 days (product choice, not law).
Art. 92(3) absences extend the real end date; the rule uses the recorded end date.
Late notice carries a penalty per overdue day (Art. 115(2)).
